conversation_starters.title: Troutman ESC Park splash pad reopens as water restrictions loosen
conversation_starters.summary: Forty counties in North Carolina are now in the Stage 1 drought category after recent rainfall made a dent in the deficit, according to the state Department of Environmental Quality. Iredell County, just north of Charlotte, NC, was one recently moved. Town officials in Troutman, a small town in Iredell County about 35 miles north of Charlotte, NC, announced mandatory water restrictions were no longer in effect.
questions: Have the drought and water restrictions been affecting your area at all?
Is the splash pad or park somewhere your colleague's family spends time?
